description:
Browser where your favorite apps won't get buried in tabs.


🍪 Biscuit Release Note

⚡️New features
- Preview links with Shift-click without leaving your current page. Move and resize the preview, or move it to a child tab when you want to keep browsing.
- Import your Arc sidebar or browser bookmarks with a guided setup, including during onboarding.
- Find visited pages and open tabs from the address bar, with compact suggestions and keyboard navigation.

💪🏻Improvements
- Moved downloads to a toolbar menu, with progress, recent files, and an animation when a download starts.
- Refreshed built-in app icons and bundled them for reliable display.

🐞Bug
- Fixed scrolling in the app catalog so every app is reachable.
